description: This bar chart illustrates the numerical values associated with different input and output sizes, labeled as 2K, 4K, 8K, and 16K. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “2K-Input”, “4K-Input”, “8K-Input”, “16K-Input”, “2K-Output”, “4K-Output”, “8K-Output”, and “16K-Output”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Number”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120000, with tick labels incrementing by 20000. Each category is represented by a pair of bars: a lighter-colored bar representing “Input” and a darker, patterned bar representing “Output”. The “2K-Input” bar is light yellow and reaches a value of approximately 9320, while the corresponding “2K-Output” bar is patterned and reaches a value of 78188. The “4K-Input” bar is orange and reaches a value of 3784, and the “4K-Output” bar is patterned and reaches a value of 108494. The “8K-Input” bar is light blue and reaches a value of 1401, while the “8K-Output” bar is patterned and reaches a value of 17865. Finally, the “16K-Input” bar is gray and reaches a value of 832, and the “16K-Output” bar is patterned and reaches a value of 4247. The bars are arranged in alphabetical order by category, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
